page.title: AI Workspace management
page.description: Manage Harness initialization knowledge, helper scripts, read-only policies and auditable sync across all user Workspaces.

panel.title: AI data analysis
panel.widenedForDialog: The harness settings dialog needs a wider surface, so the panel was widened temporarily. It restores when the dialog closes.
panel.dialogTooNarrow: The window is too narrow for the harness settings dialog; enlarge the window to see it fully.
panel.peerAlert: This Workspace is also open in another window of the same account. Conversation files may overwrite each other; SQL write-back only affects this browser tab.

workspace.promoteTitle: Convert a temporary Workspace to persistent
workspace.deleteContent: This stops the associated Harness runtime and deletes the Workspace files.

analysis.unsupportedFields: The current form cannot express these fields: {{fields}}
analysis.eventMissing: The event proposal is missing metrics or a date range
analysis.funnelOneGroup: The funnel form supports only one group
analysis.funnelGranularity: The funnel form does not support this granularity; use total
analysis.funnelIncomplete: A funnel proposal needs steps, a date range and a conversion window in whole days
analysis.retentionOneGroup: The retention form supports only one tag or cohort group
analysis.retentionIncomplete: The retention proposal is missing a start/return event, a date range or periods
analysis.proposalStale: The page conditions have changed; read them again
analysis.proposalApplyFailed: Could not fill in the analysis conditions
analysis.proposalApplied: The AI proposal was filled in automatically; you can run the query now.
analysis.proposalReceiptMissing: The conditions were filled in on this page, but no receipt arrived from the server. Check the page and reconnect so the AI can read the latest state.

connection.renewed: Connection renewed. The previous operation was not retried automatically; check the session state and try again, and reconnect to Harness if it still fails.
connection.unauthorized: Your login or project permission is no longer valid. Sign in again and reconnect to Harness. Records already saved in the session can still be recovered.
connection.recycled: The platform restarted (a release may be in progress) or the runtime was recycled. Your conversation is preserved — click “Continue” in the chat to resume; if the UI is unresponsive, use “Reconnect”.
connection.checkFailed: The Harness connection check failed; it retries once you are online. Send, cancel and execute operations are not replayed automatically.
connection.opUnauthorized: The Harness operation returned 401 and the connection is being checked; that operation is not yet confirmed as successful.
connection.offline: The network is offline. The connection is rechecked once it is back; unfinished operations are not replayed automatically.

diff.hint: Red lines are removals and green lines are additions. Confirming writes back to the editor only; nothing is executed automatically.

template.separationTitle: The initialization template is separate from user Workspaces
template.separationDescription: managed_readonly content is maintained by administrators and can be force-synced; seed_once content is written only when a Workspace is created or an old Workspace is explicitly initialized, and belongs to the user afterwards.
template.removeDirectoryContent: All draft content inside the directory will be deleted.
template.removeFileContent: Only the file in the template draft is deleted.
template.emptyHint: Select an entry on the left to edit its content, path and sync policy.
template.draftSaved: Draft saved; user Workspaces are unaffected until you publish
template.publishContent: Publishing only creates an immutable version; user Workspaces are updated separately by clicking "Sync to all Workspaces".

version.restoreContent: The current draft is kept as a server-side recovery copy first; you still have to publish again to create a new version.

sync.allContent: managed_readonly files and directories are overwritten by the administrator version; seed_once content never overwrites existing user files. A recovery copy is created for every target first.
sync.scopeAlert: Scope conditions are combined; selecting no conditions means all Workspaces
sync.scopeAlertDescription: managed_readonly content is overwritten forcefully; the system creates a recovery copy for every target first.

apply.title: Apply the new configuration now
